_readme: Alt text for the photographs, and optionally where to crop them.
Only the three shop photos need an entry: a category or trade photo
describes itself with its own title from copy.json, in whichever
language the page is in. Add a key here to say something better.
focus is where the centre of the crop sits, as a fraction of the
width and height. The default is [0.5, 0.42], slightly above centre.
Lower the second number to keep more of the top of the frame.
owner has no alt here on purpose. The About page passes the owner's name
and title as the label, so the alt text is whatever copy.json says in the
page's own language and cannot fall out of step with the caption beside it.
counter and stock are worded WITHOUT the shop's name or address, because
they may be filled by a generated image. Alt text is a description of the
picture, so it must not claim a picture of a specific premises that the
picture cannot support. shopfront keeps its address precisely because it
stays a real photograph — it is the image a customer uses to recognise the
shop from the street, and a generated one would send them past it.
